annotation.title_clean: Die Kommission veröffentlicht die Leitlinien zu verbotenen Praktiken der künstlichen Intelligenz (KI) im Sinne des KI-Gesetzes
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes the guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices under the AI Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, DG CONNECT (Shaping Europe's Digital Future)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing its 4 February 2025 guidelines on prohibited AI practices under the AI Act, covering harmful manipulation, social scoring and real-time remote biometric identification. The guidelines are non-binding, with authoritative interpretation reserved to the CJEU, and the page links to translations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines explain AI practices deemed unacceptable under the AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689).
Focus on harmful manipulation, social scoring and real-time remote biometric identification.
Guidelines are non-binding; authoritative interpretation rests with the CJEU.
Aim to ensure consistent, effective application of the AI Act across the EU.
Include legal explanations and practical examples for stakeholders.
